This browser fixture exercises the reading-width boundary with an in-flow outline.

## Planning a safe rollout and verifying the results {#planning}

The article and outline share the available space as the viewport narrows.
Continuous resizing must not make the article widen between successive drag steps.

## Confirm the result {#confirm}

The outline continues to follow the viewport while the article reaches its maximum width.
